scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Huh huh, a Rune-Midgartsian.
I guess this is your first
visit to my village, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
呵呵，一位來自盧恩·米德加茲的人。
我想，這應該是你第一次
來到我的村莊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Everyone from Rune-Midgarts
that I've met had the same
same expression on their
face as you do right now
when they first came here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我見過的每一個來自盧恩·米德加茲的人，
第一次來到這裡時，
臉上的表情都和你現在一樣。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Maybe it's because they cannot
communicate with us due to
the language barrier, so
they have no idea what's going
on. Yeah, I understand...
Anyway, welcome to my village.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
也許是因為語言不通，
無法與我們交流，
所以完全不知道發生了什麼。
嗯，我理解...
總之，歡迎來到我的村莊。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
My name is Karkatan, and I
am the chief of the Utan tribe.
You must be wondering how
I can speak your language.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我叫卡爾卡坦，
是烏坦部落的首領。
你大概在想，
我為什麼能說你們的語言吧。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
It was taught to me long ago
by an adventurer from your
land. It's been a long time,
and I do not know what has
become of him...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
這是很久以前，
一位來自你們土地的冒險者教我的。
時間過去很久了，
我也不知道他後來怎麼樣了...

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Anyhow, I learned many things
about Rune-Midgartsian culture
and language.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
總之，我學到了很多
關於盧恩·米德加茲的文化和語言。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Sometimes, I teach the Utan
language, but I do not give
everyone that privilege.
If unscrupulous outsiders
learn the Utan language, they
may bring harm to my tribe.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
有時候，我會教人烏坦語，
但我不會把這個特權給所有人。
如果居心不良的外人學會了烏坦語，
可能會給我的部落帶來傷害。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Before you can learn the Utan
language, first try to learn
Utan culture by exploring our
village.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
在你學習烏坦語之前，
先試著通過探索我們的村莊
來了解烏坦文化。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Although you are not able to
communicate with my people
right now, try to understand
our way of life through your
observations.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
雖然你現在還無法
與我的族人交流，
但試著通過觀察
來理解我們的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Pay attention to the dress,
appearance and life style of the
local people. When you think
you understand enough about Utan
culture, come back to me and show me what you have learned.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
注意當地人的穿著、
外貌和生活方式。當你覺得自己
對烏坦文化有足夠的瞭解時，
回來告訴我，向我展示你學到了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Oh, it's you again. So...
Have you learned about Utan
culture? I want to hear your
opinion, as well as your impression.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
哦，又是你。那麼...
你瞭解烏坦文化了嗎？
我想聽聽你的看法，
以及你的印象。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
There are still some villagers
who are very naive about Rune-Midgartsians.
Usually, they fear encounters
with your people and will
hide themselves.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
還有一些村民
對盧恩·米德加茲人非常天真。
通常，他們害怕遇到你們的人，
會把自己藏起來。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
So...
May I help you with anything?
I assume you did not have much of
a problem looking around the
village, but it seems you have something to ask of me.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
那麼...
有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？
我想你在村裡四處看看
應該沒有遇到什麼大問題，
但看起來你似乎有事情要問我。

scripts.text: I want to learn Utan language.
scripts.translation: 我想學習烏坦語

scripts.text: Umbabah Umbabah?
scripts.translation: 烏巴巴 烏巴巴？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Hmmm...That's an awesome mask
you're wearing. We Utans like
wearing masks to keep from
showing our facial expressions.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
嗯...你戴的面具
真不錯。我們烏坦人喜歡戴面具，
以免暴露自己的面部表情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
That's why we wear masks all the
time. We believe that interaction
and treatment of other people
should not depend on how we look.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
所以我們總是戴著面具。
我們相信，與他人的互動和對待
不應該取決於我們的外表。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Alright. I am sure you are
qualified to learn the Utan
language. I will teach you how
speak and to read in Utan from
now on.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
很好。我相信你
有資格學習烏坦語。
從現在開始，我會教你
如何用烏坦語說話和閱讀。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
However, I need you to get some
items ready so that we may proceed
with the lessons. First, we need
two different kinds of paper.
^3377FF10 Oil Paper^000000 and 
^3377FF5 Slick Paper^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
不過，我需要你準備一些
物品，以便我們開始課程。
首先，我們需要兩種不同的紙。
^3377FF10油紙^000000和
^3377FF5光滑的紙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
We'll also need something to
write with. Let's use
^3377FF1 Squid Ink^000000 and
^3377FF1 Feather of Birds^000000.
Please bring me those, and I will
teach you when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我們還需要用來書寫的東西。
讓我們使用
^3377FF1墨汁^000000和
^3377FF1鳥羽^000000。
請把這些帶給我，
當你準備好了，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
You don't seem to understand
our culture yet. You cannot
learn another language if you
do not understand the culture.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
看來你還不瞭解我們的文化。
如果不理解文化，
是無法學會另一種語言的。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
When you have that expression on
your face, Utans will be
intimidated... Since we do
not show our faces to others,
we are actually very
vulnerable to facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
當你露出那種表情時，
烏坦人會被嚇到的……
因為我們從不向他人展示面部，
所以其實非常害怕別人的面部表情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Go explore the village a little
longer. You can come back
anytime when you think you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
去村裡多逛逛吧。
等你覺得自己準備好了，
隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
In any case, what do you think
about my mask? It's the current
trend among us Utans...don't you
think it's awesome?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
話說回來，你覺得我的面具怎麼樣？
這是現在烏坦人很流行的款式……
你不覺得它很酷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Haha~ When you're just imitating
the sound, you won't make any
sense. Language is a mutual system
for the communication of thoughts and feelings.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
哈哈~ 如果只是單純模仿聲音，
是沒有任何意義的。
語言是用於交流思想和感情的共同體系。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I regret to say that it seems that
nowadays, all peoples are no
longer sensitive to other cultures
in that respect.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
很遺憾，似乎如今的人們
對異文化都不再那麼敏感了。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I see people that despise or
ridicule others that do not
understand them. It's really
sad that such bigotry still exists...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我見過一些人鄙視或嘲笑
那些無法理解他們的人。
這種偏見依然存在，真的很令人難過……

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
If you are interested in Utan
language, try to understand our
culture better and come back
when you're ready. I will
teach you the meanings of those sounds you are using.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
如果你對烏坦語感興趣，
試著更深入地瞭解我們的文化，
等你準備好了再回來。
我會教你那些聲音的含義。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Sometimes it's good to wander
without purpose. But it's
better to set a goal for
a journey if you want to
learn something out of
the experience.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
有時候漫無目的地閒逛也不錯。
但如果你想從經歷中學到東西，
最好給旅程設定一個目標。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Okay, I guess we're good to go.
Let's get the lesson started.
I hope you will communicate better
with Utans when we are done.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
好了，看來可以開始了。
讓我們開始上課吧。
希望學完後，你能更好地與烏坦人交流。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Alright, that's all. Just forget
about how you've felt about Utans
before you learned the language.
Now go try to talk to Utans.
Conversation is a very important method in understanding others.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
好了，就到這裡。
忘掉你在學習語言之前對烏坦人的看法吧。
現在去試著和烏坦人交談。
對話是理解他人的重要方式。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Okay, if you have any business
in our village later, feel free
to talk to me. I will try to help
you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
好的，如果你以後在村裡有什麼事，
儘管來找我。
我會盡力幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I guess you are not ready yet...
Did you forget what items you
need? I will let you know
again, so please bring them
so that we can start the lesson.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
看來你還沒準備好……
你忘了需要帶什麼物品了嗎？
我再告訴你一次，請把它們帶過來，
這樣我們才能開始上課。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
^3377FF10 Oil Paper^000000,
^3377FF5 Slick Paper^000000,
^3377FF1 Squid Ink^000000,
^3377FF1 Feather of Birds^000000.
When you bring all of these,
I will teach you our language.

[Karkatan]
Puchuchartan must have sent you to
me. I need to check whether or not
you are qualified to request
her help...We Utans do not want
to help evil people.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
普楚查爾坦一定是派你來找我的。
我需要確認一下，
你是否有資格請求她的幫助……
我們烏坦人不想幫助邪惡的人。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Hmmmm....
It would be good to have a mask
that was made in Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
嗯……
如果能有一頂在盧恩·米德加茲製作的面具就好了……

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I wish to have ^3377FF1 Mr. Smile^000000.
To Utans, receiving a mask as a
present is considered an
honor. Maybe Puchuchartan
wants you to show us your respect by doing so.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我想要^3377FF1笑臉面具^000000。
對烏坦人來說，收到面具作為禮物
是一種榮幸。也許普楚查爾坦
是想讓你通過這樣做來表達對我們的尊重。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Oh, you brought it! Yes, I've
always wished that I could have
this mask! This is truly an
honor! Thank you, adventurer
from Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
哦，你帶來了！是的，我一直希望能擁有這個面具！
這真是莫大的榮幸！
謝謝你，來自盧恩·米德加茲的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I will tell Puchuchartan that I
confirmed your qualification.
Go and speak to her. Though I
am not sure what help she can give
you, I hope we will be able to return this favor.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我會告訴普楚查爾坦，我已經確認了你的資格。
去和她對話吧。
雖然我不確定她能給你什麼幫助，
但我希望將來我們也能有機會回報這份恩情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Did I tell you that you need
^3377FF1 Mr. Smile^000000?
Please bring that as proof
of your goodwill, as well
as your sense of honor.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
我告訴過你需要^3377FF1笑臉面具^000000嗎？
請把它帶來，作為你善意和榮譽感的證明。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
How's it going?
I wish I could guide you around
the village, but I cannot neglect
my duty as tribal chief.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
最近怎麼樣？
我真希望能帶你逛逛村莊，
但我不能忽視作為部落首領的職責。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Leading a tribe is not as easy
as it looks. You would understand
if you were in the same position
as me. Anyway, I hope you will enjoy your time in our village.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾卡坦]
領導一個部落並不像看起來那麼容易。
如果你處在我的位置，你就會明白了。
總之，希望你在我們村莊度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務
將部分物品存入倉庫，
然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????????]
Umbah umbah umbabah Utan umbah
Umbah mookala umbabah..
Umbabahumbah umbabah
Umbabah umbaba umbaumbah umbah
Hum umbah umbah.
scripts.translation:
[??????????]
Umbah umbah umbabah Utan umbah
Umbah mookala umbabah..
Umbabahumbah umbabah
Umbabah umbaba umbaumbah umbah
Hum umbah umbah.

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I did not expect that even
more of you Rune-Midgartsians
would find my village. I am
afraid that Mother Earth may
be caused suffering because
of this...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
沒想到會有更多來自盧恩·米德加茲的人找到我的村莊。
我擔心大地母親會因此受到傷害……

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
You Rune-Midgartsians are a very
evil tribe...always accomplishing
your goals whether the means are
foul or fair, never hesitating to
ruin the property of others to get
what you want.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
你們盧恩·米德加茲人是一個非常邪惡的部落……
無論手段是否正當，都要達成目標，
為了得到想要的東西，從不猶豫破壞他人的財產。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I am worried how continuing
contact with the outside world
will affect our future...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我很擔心與外界持續接觸會如何影響我們的未來……

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
No one from Rune-Midgarts has 
visited me without some purpose
and I do not think that you
are an exception.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
從盧恩·米德加茲來找我的人，沒有一個是沒有目的的，
我想你也不例外。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I only use my power for the
service of my tribe, and do not
give my aid to strangers. If you
really need my help, go ask for
the chief's permission.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我只將我的力量用於服務我的部落，
不會幫助陌生人。
如果你真的需要我的幫助，
去請求首領的許可吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Also, I do not approve of
outsiders talking to the tribe
more than they have to...
We want to live a peaceful life, so do not disturb us.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
而且，我不贊成外來者與部落進行不必要的交談……
我們想過平靜的生活，所以請不要打擾我們。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I already told you to get the
chief's approval. There is also
the matter of my own business to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我已經告訴過你要獲得首領的批准。
而且，我也有自己的事情要處理。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I know that you have gone through
many difficulties to come here,
but you have to leave now.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我知道你經歷了許多困難才來到這裡，
但你必須現在離開。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I've heard from the chief that he
has given you his approval...
Although I do not like this, I
will keep my promise. But it's
your call if you really need my help or not.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我聽說首領已經給了你許可……
雖然我不喜歡這樣，
但我會信守承諾。
至於你是否真的需要我的幫助，由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
My power allows me to create rough
enchanted stones and to divide a
pure enchanted stone into rough
ones. So I may be able to help
you in this way.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我的力量可以製作粗糙的附魔石，
也可以將純淨的附魔石分解為粗糙的附魔石。
所以我可能可以在這方面幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So come and speak to me when
you think my power may be
of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
所以，當你認為我的力量可能對你有用時，
就來和我對話吧。

scripts.text:
[Putsuchiritan]
I don't know whether my talents
will be useful to you, but I'll
help you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[普楚奇裡坦]
我不知道我的才能是否對你有用，
但我會盡力幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Putsuchiritan]
I can create elemental essence from natural objects,
or, dismantle elemental stones into their component essences.
Which would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[普楚奇裡坦]
我可以從自然物體中創造元素精華，
或者將元素石分解為其成分精華。
你想做哪一個？

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Rune-Midgartsian who has asked for
my help...Although I am not sure
if you really need my power, I
will try to provide my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
向我請求幫助的盧恩·米德加茲人……
雖然我不確定你是否真的需要我的力量，
但我會盡力提供協助。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Wait--!
something in your possession
is disturbing my peace of
mind. This will not do...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
等等——！
你身上攜帶的某些東西
正在擾亂我的心神。
這可不行...

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Go leave your belongings
elsewhere, and only bring the
items that you need right now.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
請把你的物品放在別處，
只帶你現在需要的東西過來。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
If you refuse to do so,
I cannot do anything for you.
Get yourself ready and then
come back.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
如果你拒絕這樣做，
我就無法為你做任何事。
準備好後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Now, what do you wish to do?
My power allows me to create rough
enchanted stones and to divide a
pure enchanted stone into rough ones.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
那麼，你想做什麼？
我的力量可以製作粗糙的附魔石，
也可以將純淨的附魔石分解為粗糙的附魔石。

scripts.translation: 製作粗糙的附魔石

scripts.text: Divide a pure enchanted stone
scripts.translation: 分解純淨的附魔石

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:

enchanted stones? Which
property do you wish to create?
Earth, Water, Fire, Wind...
...choose one.

你想製作粗糙的附魔石嗎？

土、水、火、風...

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解僱

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I will try to amplify the hidden
power of natural objects in
order to create rough enchanted
stones. Choose one number from
'1' to '9.' If you wish to cancel
this request, enter '0.'
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我將嘗試放大自然物體中隱藏的力量，
以製作粗糙的附魔石。
請從'1'到'9'中選擇一個數字。
如果你想取消此請求，請輸入'0'。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I see. It's your call.
Come back when you need me.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
我明白了。由你決定。
需要我的時候再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Remember to choose a number
from 1 to 9.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]

boiling pot, and casting a

the number you entered.

記住你輸入的數字。

boiling pot, and casting a
sacred incantation. Remember
the number you entered.

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Amba Omba Zatumba! Umba! Ti!
Umputaun Eulukaba! Umba! Ha!

Datuha Ombabalaka! Umba! Si!

scripts.translation:

安巴 翁巴 扎圖姆巴！翁巴！提！

朱魯 翁巴 魯拉拉！翁巴！拉！
達圖哈 翁巴巴卡！翁巴！西！
蘇努塔巴 阿布魯姆巴！翁巴！西！

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I guess my power was not enough.
The natural power I gathered with
my spell lost focus and was scattered...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
看來我的力量還不夠。
我用咒語聚集的自然之力
失去了焦點並散逸了...

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
It seems the spirits of nature
were not in harmony at the moment.
However, if you come back later,
I will try to help you. Of course,
there will still be the same possibility that I may fail.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
似乎此刻自然的精靈們
並未處於和諧狀態。
不過，如果你稍後回來，
我會再盡力幫助你。當然，
仍然有可能失敗。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Here's the enchanted stone you
wished to have. I created this
with a lot of effort, so make
good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
這是你希望的附魔石。
我費了好大勁才製作出來，

scripts.text:

Water property...

objects that are filled with
the spirit of water.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
水屬性...
我需要充滿水之精靈力量的
自然物體。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Wind property...
I will need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of wind.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
風屬性...
我需要充滿風之精靈力量的
自然物體。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Earth property...I need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of the Earth.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
土屬性...
我需要充滿大地精靈力量的
自然物體。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:

[普楚查爾坦]
這就是我需要的全部了...
準備好了再回來吧。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Scorpion which endures the

[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:

在沙漠酷熱中生存的蠍子

[普楚查爾坦]
這就是我需要的全部了...
準備好了再回來吧。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Ambernite...the spirit of
water is contained within its
protective shell...
I will need ^3377FF20 Snail's Shell.^000000
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查爾坦]
蝸牛...水之精靈

我需要^3377FF20蝸牛殼^000000。

這就是我需要的全部了...
準備好了再回來吧。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Stainer...the beetle

[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when

I will be here.
scripts.translation:

瓢蟲...在天空中飛行的甲蟲

scripts.translation:

鍬形蟲...棲息在森林中

我需要來自鍬形蟲的^3377FF15鍬形蟲^000000。
[普楚查爾坦]
這就是我需要的全部了...
準備好了再回來吧。
我會在這裡等你。

You're carrying too
many items right now.
Put some of your stuff

come back to me, okay?
scripts.translation:

你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
把一些東西存到卡普拉倉庫，
然後再來找我，好嗎？

I'll try to revert these

scripts.translation:

我會嘗試將這些附魔石

scripts.text:
^3355FFA human skull disturbingly
hangs beside the door. The door is
locked tight, so you can't get in.
As you peer through the keyhole,
you can see somebody moving inside the room.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一個令人不安的人類頭骨
掛在門邊。門鎖得很緊，
你無法進入。
透過鑰匙孔往裡看，
可以看到房間裡有人在移動。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the skull.
scripts.translation: 檢查頭骨

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see that the eye sockets
of the skull are empty.
How peculiar...
It seems that Gemstones
would fit perfectly inside of
them.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到頭骨的眼眶是空的。
真奇怪...
似乎寶石原石
正好能放進去。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see the left eye socket of the
skull. What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到頭骨的左眼眶。
你想做什麼？^000000

scripts.text: Leave it as it is.
scripts.translation: 保持原樣

scripts.text: Insert a Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入藍色魔力礦石

scripts.text: Insert a Yellow Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入黃色魔力礦石

scripts.text: Insert a Red Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入紅色魔力礦石

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou left the eye socket as it was.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你讓眼眶保持原樣。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou inserted a {0}
into the eye socket.^000000

^3355FFThe gemstone rolled back out of
the mouth of the skull.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF寶石原石從骷髏的口中
滾了出來。^000000

^3355FF你忘記攜帶{0}了。
所以無法完成你打算做的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see the right eye socket of
the skull. What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到頭骨的右眼眶。
你想做什麼？^000000

scripts.text: Leave it as it is.

scripts.text: Insert a Blue Gemstone.

scripts.text: Insert a Red Gemstone.

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You have the feeling that the
skull is grinning at you. But...
It's probably just a trick of the light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什麼也沒發生。
你感覺頭骨正在對你微笑。但是...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly, a clicking sound comes
from the skull's eye sockets and
the door opens. Before you know
it, you walk inside as if guided
by an unseen force...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，骷髏的眼眶裡傳來咔噠咔噠的聲響，門開了。不知不覺間，你彷彿被一股無形的力量牽引著走了進去...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to pass by the door.
It looks like it might be too hard to open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定從門前經過。
這扇門看起來很難開啟。^000000

scripts.text:

I am so sick and tired of
my husband!! It's like he

in the village!

我受夠我那個丈夫了！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Hey there, cool cat.
Don't mind the wife...
Much as I love her,
I know my obligations, ya dig?
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
嘿，帥哥。
別介意我老婆...
雖然我很愛她，
但我知道自己的責任，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's got plenty, he's
got to share it with those
that got nothing to give.
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
如果一個男人擁有很多，
他就必須與那些一無所有的人分享。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's hands are good
at healin', he's got to use
those hands to help folks live.
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
如果一個男人的手擅長治癒，
他就必須用這雙手幫助人們活下去。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's lips be good at
singin', he's got to croon the
songs we like to hear so much.
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
如果一個男人的嘴唇擅長歌唱，
他就必須吟唱我們喜愛的歌曲。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
But if sweet lovin' is golden,
then baby...I got the Midas touch.
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
但如果甜蜜的愛是金色的，
那麼寶貝...我擁有點石成金的本領。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Ooh...!
...........
My back--!
Simmer down, baby, your turn is comin' in a minute~
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
噢...！
...........
我的背--！
冷靜點，寶貝，馬上輪到你了~

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Man...sometimes my wife can
be a lil' too rough, maybe
even hurtful. But that's cool...
it just means she's got fire.
scripts.translation:
[烏姆波科里奧坦]
天哪...有時候我老婆
可能有點太粗暴，
甚至有點傷人。但這沒關係...
這說明她很有激情。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
But someday, she'll have to
learn that I gots to share
this heart of mine with the ladies
who really need a dose of vitamin
